description: For every finite subset of the specified theory \(T=\{\chi_n:n\in\mathbb N\}\cup\{\neg\operatorname{Inf}\}\), some positive finite domain \(\{0,\ldots,k\}\), with constant functions and false relations, models that subset.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.noncompact_finite_models.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (F : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Sentence L))
  (hF : ↑F ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.noncompactTheory L) :
  ∃ k, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Models (ULift.{max u v, 0} (Fin (k + 1))) ↑F
